description: Get per-video audience retention for a YouTube video on a connected channel (youtube only): what percentage of viewers are still watching at each point of the video, plus performance relative to similar YouTube videos. Fetched live from the YouTube Analytics API with a 7 day cache; requires the channel to be connected with the analytics scope. Data lags about 48 hours and needs enough watch activity to exist.

accountId.description: Optional. The channel id (from list_accounts). Defaults to the first connected channel.

name: get_video_retention
title: Get Video Retention
